description: This file defines an enum type 'SmsMessageStatusType' representing various statuses of an SMS message within the system. It includes status constants with associated integer values and codes, as well as a method to convert integer status codes into enum instances.

classes.name: SmsMessageStatusType
classes.description: An enumeration of possible SMS message statuses, such as INVALID, PENDING, SENT, DELIVERED, etc., with associated numeric codes and string identifiers, including a method to map integer codes back to enum constants.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an Integer status value to the corresponding SmsMessageStatusType enum instance, defaulting to INVALID if no match is found.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer code associated with this SMS message status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code representing this SMS message status.
